findings.evidence: User fixed-word decision plus ESP-SR2.4.7 local component/model/API/archive review and pinned upstream chip defaults; no physical or target acceptance.
findings.implementation_progress: Inventory_only; actual ESP-Hi is a160x80screen robot, not headless. Ten pinned blobs and C3 SDK/source resource review recorded. Current full-engine payload floor533376bytes before algorithms/network/UI; upstream4MBfactory-only layout has no dualOTA. No C3 native profile or feature-reduced firmware introduced.
blockers: Needs a real internal-RAM automatic-wake/audio/AEC/TLS/media pipeline; current full branch allocates533376 payload bytes before overhead and explicitly uses PSRAM. Existing manual_audio_only branch disables local wake/AFE/AEC and is not authorized as the solution.
Upstream4MB layout uses one factory app+assets, not dualOTA. Need C3 app-size and model+dualOTA budget; C5 binary size cannot prove C3 size.
ADC1CH2/PDM24kpositive6-inverted7/PA3/up_sample_fs441 differs from Sensair C5 (channel5/pins7-8/PA1/fs480). Need chip-specific PDM/DMA/task, ADC owner and actual clock/echo/acoustic validation.

Screen is160x80ST-label/ILI9341API/custom18commands with runtime invertfalse/gap0,24; exact panel, reset, UI density, pins and assets need port. Servo18/19 overlapsUSB,servo20/21 overlapsUART; source console choice must be explicit. GPIO0movement GPIO1audio-wake and WS2812GPIO8 are unported.
No C3 SDK/profile/component resolution/build/device result; only existing Waveshare1.8 available. No automatic pure-button, single-app-only or headless downgrade.

fixed_wake_followup_20261112.board_remaining: No-PSRAM/internal-RAM audio, UI, authenticated TLS and dual-OTA budget still need chip-specific implementation; no manual-only alias.
limits: Static WakeNet/AFE dispatch and AEC API difference inspected; no target execution or memory/timing proof
Existing S3 AEC FD/NLP APIs missing on C3/C5/C6; must port, not disable features silently
Threshold model default plus playback0.05 is uncalibrated candidate; legacy MultiNet numeric thresholds not reused
Native source support count unchanged; profile/board audio/display/network/dualOTA implementation still incomplete

speech_component_link_followup_20261112.scope: Current fixed wake source + retained real AFE/AEC chip-library component link only; empty app_main
remaining: Full-feature no-PSRAM memory/flow-control port without disabling local wake, AFE/AEC or dual OTA
Real chip AEC mode/allocation/lifecycle integration; component symbol presence does not prove create/runtime
Per-board actual audio/display/network/dual-OTA configuration and full firmware build
Runtime model creation, RAM/stack/timing, recognition/echo/barge-in, authenticated TLS and physical acceptance

shared_reference_buffer_followup_2026111.actual_compile_scope: Current S3 audio object and complete current Spot C5 cached firmware; not other chip/board audio paths
limitations: 256 outstanding reference pushes is a new independent bound; excess is explicit playback failure before codec write
No runtime fragmented playback, capacity exhaustion, acoustic or physical acceptance
Five protocol payload caches still require at least 533376 bytes; this saving is separate and does not make full engine fit C3/C6
Control protocol human decisions and all existing board profiles unchanged

choices: Hello fixed branch declares nihaoxiaozhi; default branch declares original custom phrase
Only two approved full phrases accepted; missing field uses legacy default, unknown/empty/non-string rejected
